name: Amagi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Amagi town emblem in navy: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised pointed device.
history: Municipal flag of Amagi, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Amagi town emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised pointed device
